hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#3D405B]
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#84A59D]

typography.guidelines: Use Cormorant Garamond for elegant, botanical-feeling headers. Use Outfit for highly legible body text. The product price should be very prominent and large.

colors.guidelines: Pastel, organic, warm palette. NEVER use purple/violet gradients. Rely on sage greens, dusty pinks, creams, and sands. Use dark charcoal for text instead of pure black. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for all text.

layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, and p-12 for containers. gap-8 for product grids.

grid.products: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 sm:gap-8

components.navbar: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70), sticky top-0, z-50. Must include brand name 'cactus' in serif font, search input, share QR button, and cart icon with item count badge.
components.product_card: Minimalist. No border by default. rounded-2xl overflow-hidden. Image takes top 60-70%. Content below with left alignment. Prominent large price. Add to cart button appearing or highlighted on hover. Badges overlapping image top-left.
components.cart_drawer: Slide-in from right. Contains selected products with small thumb, name, price, and remove button. Fixed bottom section with total and 'Checkout' button.
components.verification_modal: A clean Dialog (modal) titled 'Verifique sus productos'. Shows list of items (name, code, price). Contains a form section for Delivery (Address and Phone number). A primary button 'Enviar por WhatsApp' that triggers the predefined message.
components.qr_modal: Simple modal displaying a QR code that points to the current URL. Accessible via 'Compartir' button in header.
components.admin_panel: Located exclusively at '/admin'. Needs a simple login form (admin/admin123). Once authenticated, shows a table of products and a form to add new ones (Name, Price, Image URL, Badge). Includes a mock or structural logic for 'Upload to Instagram' on submission.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or softly rounded (rounded-xl). Transition on hover: -translate-y-0.5 shadow-md.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Product cards: subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and ambient shadow (shadow-lg). Buttons: color darken and slight lift.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered fade-up for product grid items (use framer-motion).
motion_and_interactions.modals_drawers: Smooth slide/fade entrances using framer-motion or Radix UI animations.

media_and_images.guidelines: Use these images for mocking the product catalog. The aesthetic is potted cactus and botanical minimalist.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements and key informational areas MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Examples: `product-card-button`, `cart-drawer-toggle`, `checkout-whatsapp-button`, `admin-login-submit`.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG standards. DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds for components overlaid on images; use blur or semi-solid colors.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React (using .js extensions, NO .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI primitives, Framer Motion, Lucide React.
instructions_to_main_agent.general: Do not center align the app container text by default. Create depth with z-index and shadows. Implement toast notifications via Sonner. Ensure the auto-generated code is visible on the product card. When 'Enviar por WhatsApp' is clicked, generate a wa.me link with URL-encoded text containing product codes, names, total price, and the user's delivery info. Mock the Instagram upload feature with a toast notification.
instructions_to_main_agent.admin_protection: Ensure the /admin route is protected by a simple state-based login (admin/admin123).
